problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual budget across 15 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected community benefit.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.044, disruption index is 0.069, allocation limits [0.003, 0.813]  
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.038, disruption index is 0.202, allocation limits [0.056, 0.604]  
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.030, disruption index is 0.152, allocation limits [0.086, 0.535]  
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.032, disruption index is 0.086, allocation limits [0.030, 0.597]  
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.142, disruption index is 0.110, allocation limits [0.071, 0.883]  
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.195, disruption index is 0.259, allocation limits [0.049, 0.670]  
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.089, disruption index is 0.169, allocation limits [0.013, 0.512]  
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.142, disruption index is 0.286, allocation limits [0.072, 0.887]  
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.047, disruption index is 0.019, allocation limits [0.049, 0.492]  
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.132, disruption index is 0.135, allocation limits [0.011, 0.317]  
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.037, disruption index is 0.275, allocation limits [0.068, 0.327]  
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.034, disruption index is 0.121, allocation limits [0.066, 0.802]  
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.155, disruption index is 0.101, allocation limits [0.069, 0.509]  
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.158, disruption index is 0.119, allocation limits [0.057, 0.745]  
* Project O: projected benefit is 0.163, disruption index is 0.143, allocation limits [0.048, 0.316]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the sum of all shares must equal the entire budget.  
To ensure rapid implementation, the group of quick-start projects, represented by the subset Q = {A, G, H, I, J, K}, must together receive at least 0.378 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall disruption index of the portfolio must not exceed 0.212, and the total projected benefit must be at least 0.065.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
